title: Discover Kazakhstan - Almaty & Nature Wonders for 18-39s
highlights: Departure Dates: February: 26th - March: 19th - April: 16th - May: 21st - June: 18th - July: 23rd - August: 18th - September: 10th - October: 14th
Explore Almaty's history, nature, and nightlife, from the Palace of President to Charyn Canyon and Kok-Tobe, for an unforgettable journey. This package is exclusively for those 18-39.
Discover Almaty's story at the Palace of President and Zilyoni Bazaar, and treat yourself at Rakhat Chocolate Factory shop.
Enjoy the beauty of nature at Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lakes.
Relax in the mountains with the Meadows & Shymbulak Tour.
Admire amazing views from the top of Kok-Tobe.
inclusions: Transfer from Almaty International Airport to Deluxe Hotel
5 nights stay in Almaty with breakfast
Transfer from Visit Mega Mall to Almaty International Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: Keep your passport with you at all times.
Arrange separately for any activities or transfers not specified in the itinerary.
Respect local customs and dress modestly, especially when visiting religious sites.
Consider bringing a pocket Wi-Fi or downloading offline maps due to limited and potentially expensive internet availability.
The package covers specific meals only; plan and pay separately for personal dining, alcoholic drinks, travel insurance, and other expenses.
Visa expenses are not covered; they must be obtained separately.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Almaty
days.desc: Upon your arrival in Almaty, get transferred to your hotel for check-in and rest. In the evening, you can explore Arbat Street, museums, Zenkov’s Cathedral, the Mahatma Gandhi Statue, and many more attractions at your own pace. Later, head to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Rakhat Chocolate Factory Tour
items.desc: The factory boasts a legacy dating back to 1942, where time-honored craftsmanship converges with modern innovation. From rich cocoa blends to truffles, Rakhat's extensive range offers to diverse palates. Visitors to the factory are greeted by the delicious aroma of chocolate, offering a sensory journey through the chocolate-making process.

days.title: Medeo & Shymbulak Resort Tour | Excursion to Zelyony bazaar
days.desc: Begin your day by visiting the stunning mountain surroundings of Almaty. Explore Medeo- an ice skating rink and visit Shymbulak ski resort. Get transferred to the Zelyony bazaar, to get yourself some chocolates, dry fruits, and souvenirs. Conclude your day by getting transferred to your hotel.

items.title: Meadows & Shymbulak Tour
items.desc: Visit the beautiful and adventurous world-known mountain skating rink Meadows in Almaty. Whereas, Shymbulak is a Ski resort in Almaty sitting in an attractive gorge of the Zailii Alatau at a height of 2,260 m above sea level.

items.title: Visit Zelyony bazaar
items.desc: Located in the bustling streets of Moscow, Zelyony Bazaar is a cultural gem that captivates visitors with its lively atmosphere. This bustling market, adorned with colorful stalls, showcases a diverse array of fresh produce, local delicacies, and handmade crafts.

days.title: Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake Adventure
days.desc: Start your tour to Charyn Canyon and Kolsai Lake in the morning. Admire the natural red sandstone formation of the canyon. Afterward, visit the beautiful Kolsai Lakes, known for their turquoise waters and scenic views. Conclude your day by getting transferred back to the hotel.

items.title: Charyn Canyon Sightseeing Tour
items.desc: Charyn Canyon, located in southeastern Kazakhstan, is a geological marvel often referred to as the "Grand Canyon's little brother." Spanning over 150 kilometers along the Charyn River, this natural wonder is renowned for its breathtaking red-rock formations, towering cliffs, and intricate maze of gorges.

items.title: Excursion to Kolsai Lakes
items.desc: Located along the northern edge of the famous Tuan Shan Ridge, the Kolsai Lakes National Park is one of the most placid and auspicious attractions in Kazakhstan.

days.title: Kok-Tobe Mountain Adventure
days.desc: Start your day with a tour to Kok-Tobe, the highest point in Almaty. Explore the recreational area with amusement park attractions and restaurants. Get transferred to your hotel, the evening is yours to explore the amazing nightlife. Relax and enjoy an overnight stay at the hotel.
